page: Microsoft Azure E372ids_v7 is an isolated memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by x86_64 Intel processors. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 372 dedicated vCPUs alongside 2832 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration is positioned to deliver massive single-node scaling without hypervisor-level resource contention from co-tenants.

Hardware storage capabilities include 22680 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity, supplemented by compatibility with Azure Premium Storage for external managed persistent disks. The instance contains zero discrete GPU accelerators and allocates no complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on dedicated networking infrastructure for inbound and outbound traffic routing.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, deploying such high core counts and memory density onto a single isolated physical node avoids the network latency overhead typical of multi-node distributed clusters. However, it concentrates single-node architectural dependency and demands software capable of effectively scaling across hundreds of concurrent threads. The E372ids_v7 is structured for massive in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning platforms, high-throughput transactional database engines, and heavy analytical data processing.
description: Microsoft Azure E372ids_v7 is an isolated, memory-optimized instance engineered for enterprise applications requiring large memory capacity and dedicated compute density. Powered by x86_64 Intel processors running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features 372 dedicated vCPUs and 2832 GB of system memory, maintaining a ratio of approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per core. The server bundles 22680 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Azure Premium Storage, delivering extensive low-latency scratch space. The configuration operates without discrete GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By consolidating massive memory, extreme thread counts, and substantial local solid-state storage onto an isolated physical host, the E372ids_v7 eliminates noisy-neighbor performance variability. This profile is suited for massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, large-scale transactional processing systems, heavy data warehousing operations, and high-throughput real-time analytical workloads requiring high single-system capacity.
